title: I build this game using AI because I want to play it
author: monster_lurker
selftext:
This game has been in my mind for the past 5 years. It takes inspiration from Monster Hunter and NES Punch Out. I develop software professionally for 10 years, but I have little to no game dev experience.   
  
I tried to build this game 5 times.. 2 of them uses AI assisted development. all 5 of them failed to reach prototype quality. Today, i made this game within few hours. using OhMyPI with openrouter + qwen 3.8 Flash + godot + my own plan markdown.

you know the feeling of finally found the item you lost years ago? this. im crying.

hello Close Quarter Hunter... im glad you came into my life... why you so late... x'(
